content: Bulu Tamakɩ Ɔha Ansɩ́tɔ́
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ fʋ́á fʋtsie fʋdɛ fʋ́ aba ɩlá lɛ, fʋma ɔnɔ́ kʋkʋ lɛ́ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́. Tsúfɛ́ fʋdɛ akʋ ɩlá lɛ, támɛ fʋdɛ mʋ́ odu kɛ́n bwɛ. Mʋ́ sʋ nɩ́ fʋdɛ amʋ́ ɩlá lɛ á, ɩwɩ pɔ́n fʋ́dɛha.
Anɩyin ánɩ́ Bulu ɔbɛ́ha ahá ánɩ́ bʋdɛ ɩ́nɩ odu bwɛ ɩpɔ́n. Anɩyin ɛ́ ánɩ́ mʋ asʋ́n da ɔkpa.
Mʋ́ sʋ nɩ́ fʋ́dɛ ahá ɩlá lɛ lakpan ánɩ́ fʋ́ onutó fʋ́dɛbwɛ sʋ á, bɩ ánɩ́ Bulu ɛ́ ɔbɛ́ha fʋ́ ɩpɔ́n. Fʋmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ kɔlɩ dalɩ mʋ ɩbɩ. Ntɛ́ɛ fʋmeyín alɩ?
Bulu lalɛ́ mʋ yilé pʋ́ mʋ awɩtɔlɛ ɔwan súná fʋ́, alanyá klʋn há fʋ́, támɛ fʋmobu mʋ. Ntɛ́ɛ fʋmeyín ánɩ́ alɩá fɛ́damlí klʋntɔ yínkí ba mʋ wá sʋ alalɛ́ mʋ awɩtɔlɛ súná fʋ́?
Támɛ klʋntɔ bʋ fʋ odwin, asʋtɔ bʋ fʋ ɔnlɩn. Mʋ́ sʋ ɩsʋtɔbɩtɩ́ ánɩ́ ɩda gyo fʋ́ ɛkɛá Bulu Ɔnɔkwalɩpʋ obégyi asʋ́n ɩtráa démoní tsɩ́a.
Bulu ɔbɛ́ka ɔhagyíɔha ɩkɔ mʋ bwɛhɛ́ ɔnɔ́.
Akʋ bapʋ́ ansɩ́ dɩ́nká ánɩ́ bénya numnyam, ɩdayilé pʋ́ nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá. Mʋ́ sʋ banyá klʋn bʋdɛ yilé bwɛ ekekegyíɛkɛ. Amʋ́ Bulu ɔbɛ́ha nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá nɩ́.
Támɛ akʋá bʋbʋ ɔnsɩ́pɛ, bakíná ɔnɔkwalɩ amʋ pʋ́ yilébwɛ, bʋbuo lalahɛ mʋ́ á, Bulu ɔbɔ́pʋ ɔblɔ́ gyi amʋ́ asʋ́n, bɩ́tɩ́ amʋ́ ɩsʋ wankláán.
Asʋn wunhɛ mʋ́a ɩwɩɔsɩn bɛ́ba lalahɛ abwɛpʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́. Ibégyankpá tʋ́ Yudafɔ, asa ɩbɔ́tʋ ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ.
Támɛ Bulu ɔbɔ́wa yilé abwɛpʋ́ numnyam, há amʋ́ iwilwii, trá ha amʋ́ ayɛ. Obégyankpá há Yudafɔ, asa ɩbɔ́tʋ ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ.
Tsúfɛ́ Bulu tegyi asʋ́n ɔnɔkwalɩsʋ, ɔtamakɩ ɔhaa ansɩ́tɔ́.

Ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋmeyín Mose Mbla ámʋ, bʋdɛ lakpan bwɛ ámʋ óó bɔ́fwɩ. Támɛ Bulu mɔ́ɔpʋ mbla ámʋ gyi amʋ́ asʋ́n. Ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋyin mbla ámʋ asa bʋdɛ lakpan bwɛ ámʋ mʋ́ á, Bulu ɔbɛ́lɩɩ́ mbla ámʋsʋ há amʋ́ ɩpɔ́n.
Tsúfɛ́ megyí ahá ánɩ́ bʋyin Mose Mbla ámʋ asʋ́n da ɔkpa Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́. Mboún ahá ánɩ́ bʋtegyi mʋ́sʋ́.
Ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́á ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ bʋmeyín Mose Mbla ámʋ. Támɛ nɩ́ amʋ́ onutó bʋdɛ mbla ámʋsʋ gyí a, bʋdesuná ánɩ́ bʋyin yilé mʋ́a lalahɛ amʋ́ klʋntɔ.

Amʋ́ bwɛhɛ́ ánfɩ desuná ánɩ́ Bulu lɔ́wanlɩ́n mbla ámʋ dɩ́nká amʋ́ klʋnsʋ. Amʋ́ klʋn dɛ adánsɩɛ gyí ánɩ́ lɛ́lɛ́ bʋyin mʋ́. Tsúfɛ́ brɛ́ kʋtɔ á, amʋ́ agywɩɩn tɛhá amʋ́ ɩpɔ́n, brɛ́ kʋtɔ ɛ́ á, ɩtɛhá amʋ́ asʋ.
Alɩ kɛ́n ɩbɛ́ba ɛkɛ ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ɔbɔ́tsʋn Yesu Kristosʋ gyi tɔ́á ahá babwɛ́ ŋáintɔ ɩwɩ asʋ́n nɩ́. Alɩ́ Kristo ɩwɩ asʋn wankláán ámʋ́ʋ́ ndɛ mʋ́ ɔkan da ámʋ idesuná nɩ́.
Yudafɔ Pʋ́ Mose Mbla
Fʋ́ fɛɛ Yudayin fʋgyi, fʋ́ ansɩ́ dɩn Mose Mbla ámʋsʋ, fʋ́dɛpʋ ɩbɩ sí kántɔ́ fɛɛ Bulu mʋ bi fʋ́gyi.
Fʋyin Bulu apɛ́, tsúfɛ́ fakásɩ́ Mose Mbla ámʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ fʋyin tɔ́á ɩbʋ alɛ́.
Fʋtɛkɩ fʋ́ ɩwɩ ansibi abwiepʋ́ ɔkpapʋ́, fʋ́gyi fɛ́ ɔkandɩ́ɛ há ahá ánɩ́ bʋmeyín Bulu, basin oklúntɔ.
Fʋ́ fɛɛ fʋgyi aha mimláhɛ ansɩ́ ɔtɩ́npʋ. Fɛ́talɩ́ súná ahá ánɩ́ bʋmeyín ɔlala tɔ́á ɩbʋ alɛ́. Tsúfɛ́ fatsúlá fɛɛ Mose Mbla ámʋ sʋ fabɩ́ tógyítɔ́, fabɩ́ ɔnɔkwalɩ kugyíkʋ ɛ́.
Támɛ ɩ́nɩá fʋ́dɛ ahá yilé suná á, ntogyi sʋ fʋmóosuná fʋ́ ɩwɩ mʋ́? Fʋdɛ ɔkan da bláa ahá fɛɛ bʋmáwi atɔ́, támɛ fʋ́ onutó fʋdewi?
Fɛɛ bʋmátɔ mbʋa, támɛ fʋdɛ mbʋa tɔ? Fɛɛ bʋmásum ɩkpɩ, támɛ fʋtowí ɔkpɩasɩ atɔ́.
Fʋtotsú ɩwɩ Mose Mbla ámʋ sʋ, támɛ fʋtɛpán mʋ́sʋ́. Ɩ́nɩ sʋ fʋdɛ Bulu kpɔɩ́.
Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ lɛ́blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩ Yudafɔ bwɛhɛ́ sʋ ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ bʋdɛ Bulu ɩwɩ asʋn laláhɛ blɩ́.”
Nɩ́ mlɩdɛ́ Bulu mbla ámʋsʋ gyí á, mlɩ ketétɩ́ɩn bʋ labi. Támɛ nɩ́ mlɩtamagyi mʋ́sʋ́ á, mlɩgyí fɛ́ ahá ánɩ́ bʋmɛtɩn keté.
Nɩ́ ɔkʋ mɛ́tɩn keté, ɔdɛ Mose Mbla ámʋsʋ gyí a, ogyi fɛ́ keté ɔtɩ́npʋ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́.
Mlɩ Yudafɔ mlɩyin mbla ámʋ, tsúfɛ́ bɔwanlɩ́n mʋ́ tswɩ mlɩ, bɛtɩn mlɩ keté ɛ́, támɛ mlɩtɛpán Mose Mbla ámʋsʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔmɛtɩn keté kʋ́ráá, támɛ ɔdɛ mbla ámʋsʋ gyí ɔbɛ́lɛ mlɩ ɩlá.
Tsúfɛ́ megyí keté ɔtɩ́npʋ gyí Yudayin onutó. Ketétɩ́ɩn onutónutó bʋ ɩnʋ. Megyí ɔyʋlʋ́sʋ ketétɩ́ɩn kɛkɛ.

Nɩ́ ɔkʋ gyí Yudayin onutónutó á, mʋ klʋntɔ tósúná. Ketétɩ́ɩn onutó itsú klʋntɔ. Bulu Ɔŋɛ́ ámʋ tɔ́bwɛ́ mʋ́, megyí mbla ámʋ́ʋ́ bɔwanlɩ́n tswɩ amʋsʋ gyí. Ɔhá ánɩ́ Bulu Ɔŋɛ́ ámʋ ɩlɛtɩn mʋ keté á, Bulu onutó tɛ́kánfʋ́ mʋ, megyí nyankpʋsa.
